# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This project is a Flask-based Sudoku game. Refactor the legacy code into clean, modular, and maintainable Python while preserving functionality.

## Coding Style
- Follow PEP 8 standards.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Write reusable functions.
- Add comments where necessary.
- Include error handling using try/except where appropriate.

## Project Structure
- Keep backend logic separate from frontend code.
- Organize HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python files logically.
- Do not duplicate code.

## Game Requirements
Implement:
- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels.
- One unique Sudoku solution.
- Locked prefilled cells.
- Timer.
- Hint button.
- Check button.
- Completion message.
- Top 10 leaderboard stored in local storage.
- Dark mode.
- Responsive design.

## Testing
- Help generate unit tests.
- Do not remove existing functionality.
- Ensure tests pass after every change.

## UI
- Support light and dark mode.
- Mobile responsive.
- Alternate colors for each 3×3 Sudoku box.
- Keep the interface clean and readable.

## Copilot Behavior
- Explain complex code before suggesting it.
- Prefer simple, maintainable solutions.
- Suggest modular code instead of long functions.
- Avoid unnecessary libraries unless requested.
